name: Scorpions Tribute Symphonic Experience
description: Experience the legendary rock anthems of the Scorpions as the National Youth Orchestra and Mercury Falls Band unite for a powerful symphonic fusion.
longDescription:
The Scorpions Tribute Symphonic Experience brings together the iconic rock repertoire of the German band Scorpions with a full orchestral arrangement. This unique musical event features the National Youth Orchestra performing alongside the Mercury Falls Band, creating a fusion of classical and rock instrumentation. The concert aims to reinterpret classic Scorpions hits, presenting them in a new symphonic context while maintaining the original energy and melodic strength of the songs.

Attendees can expect a dynamic performance within the grand setting of Casa da Música, a renowned architectural landmark in Porto known for its excellent acoustics. The event is designed to appeal to both long-time fans of the Scorpions and those interested in innovative musical collaborations. The atmosphere will blend the intensity of a rock concert with the sophistication of an orchestral performance, offering a distinct auditory experience.

Tickets for the Scorpions Tribute Symphonic Experience are available from €25. Casa da Música is located near the Carolina Michaelis metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F), approximately a 5-minute walk. Several bus lines also serve the area. The venue is accessible.
